reason: The branded app and the cash-drawer checks look nice, but my team already knows how to bill the way we do it now. I'm not paying ₹4,999 upfront and retraining my stylists just to get roughly what I've already got.
objection: Why switch and move all my customer data when I can already bill and send bills? And after losing two stylists last year, I don't want selfie check-ins and new rules annoying the ones I have left.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee: you move my existing customer list over for free and I try it for a month. If I'm not happy, I walk away without paying anything.
